ModMetaData.name: Bill Autopilot - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Bill Autopilot, run by Pickle. Development only: never published, never part of the distributed Mod/ folder.
Written, not yet run. The suite deliberately holds only what a running game can show: bills appearing and coming down on a real bench, the confirmation dialog, the mark in a real bill label, the drift capture through a real bill edit, the per-bench memory across a real down-and-up cycle, and the save round trip. The arithmetic underneath - which mode applies, which target, which floor, the clamps, the overflow guard and the settings round trip - is proven out of game by Tests/BillAutopilot.Tests.csproj and is not replayed here.
The name Pickle's -pickle-run filter wants is the display name above, not the folder.
See TESTING.md for the scenarios this suite comes from, and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is covered here, what stays manual, and how many passes a verdict needs.
